task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grab the playingcards box with white accents with the left arm and set left of the soft square bread
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架后用左臂抓取带有白色口音的扑克牌盒，放置在柔软的方形面包左侧
